Container.Name: packing-tracker
Container.Overview: Track what is in each moving box, where it is and which room it goes to. Prints box labels at 4x6, 3x2 or 2x1 inches (Rollo or any label printer), with QR codes that open the box on your phone. One shared password; data is stored in a single SQLite file in the appdata folder. For your home network only: do not forward the port to the internet.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the web page. Open http://[unraid-ip]:PORT in your browser.

Config.Name: Data folder
Config.Description: Where the box database (tracker.db) is stored. Back up this folder.

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: Shared password for the tracker, at least 8 characters. The container will not start without it. Changing it signs everyone out.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Address phones use to open the tracker, e.g. http://192.168.1.50:5639. QR codes on labels point here. Leave empty to use whatever address you print from.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as. 99 is Unraid's 'nobody'.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as. 100 is Unraid's 'users'.
